title: Keep the analyzer working when source generation is suppressed

authorDescription.text: This change makes the analyzer keep working on types marked with SuppressSourceGeneration = true, which stopped in version 3.1.1 (issue 2234). Those types are still serialized at run time, so they still need a valid contract. The cause was in the type collector: duplicate integer or string keys, and members whose key kind differed from the rest, made it throw while building its member tables. It now adds a key only if it is not already present, and skips a member with a mismatched key kind after the diagnostic has been reported. The analyzer therefore reports the problem instead of failing. I added analyzer tests for missing keys, AllowPrivate, duplicate keys and mixed key kinds, plus two generator tests for suppressed types. The README gains a section on opting out of source generation and lists which diagnostics still apply.
